title: LibScript RTOS & Embedded Firmware Execution Plan Schema
description: Declarative execution plan schema codifying the solved build graph for Zephyr RTOS and FreeRTOS firmware, simulator binaries, Devicetree/Kconfig merges, MCUboot signing stages, and multi-node Renode/QEMU edge pods.

plan_version.description: Semantic version identifier of the RTOS execution plan format

profile_name.description: Identifier of the synthesized RTOS profile or appliance configuration

execution_mode.description: Execution mode distinguishing standalone RTOS firmware, host simulator binaries, and multi-node edge/cloud simulation pods

target.description: Resolved target hardware architecture, C runtime, RTOS kernel, and board specification

arch.description: Target CPU or MCU instruction set architecture

libc.description: Resolved C library or freestanding runtime selected for firmware linkage

os_family.description: Declarative OS family identifier from synthesis/schemas/os-config.schema.json

board.description: Target Zephyr board name or FreeRTOS BSP/simulator port

compiler.description: Selected C/C++ compiler backend (default, gcc, clang, tcc, edgcpp, msvc, custom-cc)

rtos_build.description: Resolved RTOS configuration synthesis, heap allocation, and cryptographic signing parameters

dts_overlays.description: Ordered Devicetree overlay files merged into the target board DTS

kconfig_fragments.description: Ordered Kconfig or FreeRTOSConfig.h override fragments

heap_implementation.description: FreeRTOS heap allocator scheme or static-only allocation policy

mcuboot_signed.description: Indicates whether stage3 signs the synthesized binary for MCUboot A/B slots

stages.description: Ordered list of deterministic RTOS toolchain, static payload, firmware linkage, and signing stages

items.description: Single build stage within the RTOS synthesis DAG

stage.description: Canonical stage identifier (e.g. stage0-rtos-sdk, stage2-target-sysroot, stage3-rtos-firmware, stage3-rtos-pod)

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the build stage

tasks.description: Ordered atomic component execution tasks within this stage

items.description: Atomic component build, configuration merge, or packaging task

name.description: Unique task name within the execution plan

component.description: Relative repository path to the T1 or T3 LibScript component

action.description: Lifecycle action verb executed for the component

stamp.description: Idempotency completion stamp filename written atomically upon verification

variants.description: Active variant flags enabled for this component task

env.description: Scoped environment variables passed to the component task
